_base.description: Base config that all subsequent analyzers, even unspecified will inherit.

exclude_files.external/.*: exclude all files under external/gazelle~ for all analyzers
exclude_files.^external/$: exclude all files under external/gazelle~ for all analyzers

exclude_files.src/foo\\.go: manually verified that behavior is working-as-intended

exclude_files.src/(third_party|vendor)/.*: enforce DOM safety requirements only on first-party code

exclude_files.external/.*: exclude all files under external/gazelle~ for all analyzers
exclude_files.^external/$: exclude all files under external/gazelle~ for all analyzers

exclude_files.pkgs/v1/schemaorg/generated/.*: generated schema.org types have duplicate JSON tags from struct embedding

generated OpenAPI client code cannot be modified
exclude_files.pkgs/v1/sentinel/client/generated/.*: generated OpenAPI client code cannot be modified
